relationships.subject: SCN9A zinc finger repressor
relationships.evidence_quote: ST-503 administration by IT-lumbar infusion resulted in 50% repression of SCN9A in bulk DRG tissue at 6 months without findings of dose-limiting toxicity or impact on neurological and cardiac safety pharmacology.

relationships.subject: SCN9A zinc finger repressor
relationships.evidence_quote: In the spared nerve injury (SNI) neuropathic pain mouse model, AAV-ZFR administration resulted in ≤70% repression of Scn9a in mouse dorsal root ganglia (DRGs) and was associated with reduction in pain hypersensitivity.

key_findings: AAV-delivered zinc finger repressors selectively repress SCN9A (Nav1.7) in human iPSC neurons, mouse DRG, and NHP nociceptors without detectable off-target activity.
Lead AAV9-ZFR ST-503 gave 50% SCN9A repression in NHP DRG at 6 months without dose-limiting toxicity.
